Sinhala Input - portable install (Windows 10/11, unsigned)

1. Unzip this folder somewhere (e.g. your Desktop).
2. Double-click Install.cmd. If Windows warns about an unknown publisher, choose
   "More info" > "Run anyway". Allow the administrator prompt.
3. Settings > Time & language > Language & region > add Sinhala, then
   Language options > Add a keyboard > "Sinhala Input".
4. Restart Word. Press Win+Space to pick "Sinhala Input" and type, e.g.  niladhaari

Ctrl+Shift+Space turns Sinhala typing on and off.
To remove: double-click Uninstall.cmd.

Problem? Create an empty file  %LOCALAPPDATA%\SinhalaInput\enable-log , repeat the problem,
and send debug.log from that folder.
